subject: general
question: Who was the first speaker of the Lok Sabha after India's Independence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ganesh V Mavalankar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganesh V Mavalankar** was the first speaker of the Lok Sabha after India's Independence.
 
• He served as the Speaker from 1952 to 1956.
 
• He played a significant role in establishing parliamentary traditions in the newly independent India.
 
• Mavalankar was instrumental in shaping the office of the Speaker and setting the standards for its functioning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The role of the Speaker is crucial in maintaining the order and decorum of the House and ensuring that the business is conducted smoothly.
 
• The Speaker's decisions are final and binding on all members of the House.
 
• The Speaker represents the House in all its powers, proceedings, and dignity.
 
• Ganesh V Mavalankar was also known as the "Father of the Lok Sabha" due to his significant contributions to the legislative process.
